Title: UI Operational Integration and Command Orchestration
Summary: The WPF operator console is now a safe command shell over the existing governed DevBridge lifecycle. Every action routes through a UI-owned operator command catalog (OperatorCommandCatalog) that points at the existing DB-M03-DB-M11 backend scripts; OperatorCommandService runs the scripts and validates the REFRESHED state transition, never the exit code alone (BACKEND_STATE_MISMATCH). Commands with no durable backend entry point (completion/verification/review-packet/claude-record/workbook-validation) stay GUIDED_MANUAL_ACTION with the exact reason recorded - never faked. Claude verdict evidence entry, clipboard status, workbook-write operator confirmation, busy/double-click protection, live command output and stale-cycle evidence gating are all wired.

GuidedManualReasons.RUN_GOVERNED_COMPLETION: Complete-Workbook-DBM10.ps1 is one-time generated logic hard-coded to CHG-20260830-016 / WI-07-0.2.3 - unsafe to auto-invoke for a fresh cycle
GuidedManualReasons.RECORD_CLAUDE_RESULT: DB-M08 has no reusable command entry point; UI provides safe evidence-entry dialog
GuidedManualReasons.VALIDATE_WORKBOOK: No durable orchestrator script writes state/workbook-consistency.json
